timeline_convention: Host callbacks are consecutive half-open ranges on one absolute host frame counter. For reduced ratio p/q=48000/F_host, source boundary B(H)=ceil(H*p/q). A host event at E is delivered before source frame B(E), never earlier, and equal mapped frames retain ingress order. Non-bypass output is delayed by L_h=ceil(65*q/p) host frames; reset restarts both counters at zero.
title: Tide Pit and Pamplist Fixed-Rate VST3 Resampling

tolerances.alias_23000_to_44100: bandlimited RMS below -70 dBFS after transient exclusion and unfiltered comparator at or above -40 dBFS
tolerances.allocation_probe: zero adapter-owned C++ heap allocations during repeated non-bypass processing
tolerances.direct_48000_pcm: exact float equality for both predecessor processor suites
tolerances.event_mapping: exact B(E), monotone, never early, equal-frame order preserved
tolerances.finite_pcm: all output finite; instrument fixtures within [-1,1] and nonzero after reported latency
tolerances.latency: impulse peak and processor-reported delay equal ceil(65*q/p) host frames within one sample only where the bandlimited impulse has an equal adjacent maximum
tolerances.source_count: exact B(H) at every tested prefix independent of partition
tolerances.unsupported_shape: exact available-channel silence and unprepared or incremented bounded failure state
